# CANDIDATE: SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK_TOP_KEEPER

**Filed:** 2026-07-17  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK strategy captures edge by entering on institutional-level breaks with volume and body confirmation, then exiting via a premium-defined profit target and runner target. The edge exists because level breaks with institutional participation (high volume, meaningful body) often precede sustained moves, especially when aligned with the prevailing trend structure.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Trigger when SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK fires with: volume ≥ vol_mult (1.3) × 20-bar average VWAP volume, candle body size ≥ body_min_cents ($0.05), quality score ≥ min_stars (2), strike_offset = 2 (ITM-2 puts), and require_break_above_open = true (break must occur above session open price).  
**Exit:**  
- Premium stop at premium_stop_pct = -0.08 (8% loss from entry premium)  
- TP1 at tp1_premium_pct = 0.4 (40% gain) on tp1_qty_fraction = 0.667 of position  
- Runner target at runner_target_pct = 1.5 (150% gain) on remaining position  
- Profit lock not activated (profit_lock_threshold_pct = 0.0)
